description: Household net worth by age of the household head in a country: the median and the top 10% and top 1% cutoffs for each age group (under 35, 35 to 44 … 75 or older). Pass an age to single out its group. Use for 'what is the average net worth at 30', 'top 1% net worth at 40 in the US' or 'median net worth by age in Germany'. US medians are the Federal Reserve's; other countries are labeled estimates.

age.description: Optional age: marks the age group it falls in.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, DE, JP).

name: net_worth_by_age
title: Net worth by age
